messages.content: Please look up some headphones in electronics for me, then check recommendations based on the Sony XM5 black option, specifically product_id p_sony_xm5_blk, and proceed to check out the best recommendation for 1 unit on my account for user_id user_123. After that, generate one invoice for item p_sony_xm5_blk, quantity 1, using the SAVE15 coupon, PayPal with payment_gateway paypal, and send it to alice@company.com. Then generate another invoice for the same item using the best available discount. Also check the current BTC price on CRYPTO, do an express checkout for the Sony XM5 black using payment_method card, check whether the crypto market is open, get the USD to EUR exchange rate, and place a buy order for symbol BTC on exchange CRYPTO at 42000.5 using my risk token risk_tok_abc123.
